Description: Unaligned non retail sales for DDDMD source at L1 Level
Sample Queries:
SELECT DISTINCT
    A.*,
    B.prod_nm
FROM (
    SELECT *
    FROM cdp.fct_nonret_sls_trans_wkly
) AS A
LEFT JOIN cdp.dmn_prod AS B
    ON A.prod_sid = B.prod_sid
   AND A.prod_lst_id = B.prod_lst_id
WHERE A.caln_dt >= '2026-08-01'
  AND (
      UPPER(B.prod_nm) LIKE '%RYBREVANT%'
      OR UPPER(B.prod_nm) LIKE '%LAZCLUZE%'
  );
Notes:
Business Rules:
• Use weekly non-retail sales transactions from cdp.fct_nonret_sls_trans_wkly.
• Join to cdp.dmn_prod using both prod_sid and prod_lst_id.
• Retain products whose names contain RYBREVANT or LAZCLUZE (case-insensitive).

Description: Unaligned retail sales for Xponent at L0(HCP Level)
Sample Queries:
select A.jnj_id, B.prod_nm, caln_dt ,sum(tot_rx_equiv_uns) as equ_trx 
from (select *, extract(month from caln_dt) as month,extract(quarter from caln_dt) as quarter, extract(year from caln_dt) as year
from cdp.fct_ret_sls_trans_wkly
where thrc_class_cd like '%PRC%' and caln_dt >= '2026-01-01'
     ) as A 
left join(select prod_sid, prod_lst_id, prod_nm from cdp.dmn_prod) as B
on A.prod_sid = B.prod_sid and A.prod_lst_id = B.prod_lst_id

group by 1,2,3
having B.prod_nm in ('RYBREVANT', 'LAZCLUZE','RYBREVANT FASPRO')
Notes:
Business Rules:
• Use weekly retail sales transactions from cdp.fct_ret_sls_trans_wkly
• Restrict therapeutic class codes to values containing PRC.
• Join product details using both prod_sid and prod_lst_id.
• Include only exact product names: RYBREVANT, LAZCLUZE, and RYBREVANT FASPRO.

Description: Reference table of NDC codes used to identiy lung cancer treatment market basket.

Sample Queries:
select  
    position_name,
    product_name,
    messages,
    count(distinct call_id) as calls
from cdp.vw_ce_call_activity_dly as A
where call_date >= '2026-03-15' and call_date<='2026-05-15'
  and upper(status) = 'SUBMITTED' 
  and (
        upper(position_name) like '%250-OL%' 
      )
group by 1,2,3
Notes:
Business Rules:
• Use daily call activity from cdp.vw_ce_call_activity_dly.
• Include only records with status SUBMITTED.
• Restrict position names to values containing 250-OL or 250-PS.
• Count distinct call IDs by position name, product name, and message.

Additional Description:
250-OL is the OS selling division for Lung. 250-PS is the OCE selling division; when analyzing OCE activity, filter product_name for RYB or LAZ because the team also calls on Inlexzo. This additional guidance is not implemented in the sample query.
